description: DUT-level independent RTL defect index. One entry per deduplicated RTL root defect; model names record which models found it.

source.selection: explicitly selected, semantically classified root IDs; unresolved roots are moved to the manual audit queue
source.deduplication: one GT defect per source_root_id; multiple BUG-* symptoms map to one defect
source.model_membership: recomputed from current rtl_root_bugs.models[*].found for every benchmark revision
source.identity_matching: adjudicated defect matched to current root by normalized RTL file, overlapping line interval, and failure mode; positional RTLBUG IDs are not stable identity
